# Switchboard buttons

Every tool the switchboard offers, who may press it, and what happens when they do.
**read** = runs on its own and is logged. **approve** = posts a request to the Discord approvals channel, @-mentions the approver, and returns a request id at once; it runs only on the approver's own ✅ (or passkey approval) within 30 minutes (their ❌ denies; anyone else's reaction, the bot's included, is ignored). Max 3 pending per agent; a restart expires anything pending.

| Tool | Tier | Backend | Agents | What it does | Arguments |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `guest_list` | read | prometheus | coder | Every Proxmox VM and container on the hypervisor: vmid, name, kind, running or stopped, max memory. From Prometheus, so up to ~15 s old. | none |
| `host_health` | read | prometheus | coder | CPU busy %, memory and root-disk space for one host, from Prometheus node metrics. | `host` (Host name as Prometheus labels it, e.g. pve1) |
| `jellyfin_library_counts` | read | jellyfin | coder | How many movies, series, episodes, songs, albums etc. are in Jellyfin. | none |
| `jellyfin_library_scan` | approve | jellyfin | coder | Start a Jellyfin library scan (picks up new or removed media). Never runs straight away: it posts a request to the approver in Discord and returns a request id; it runs only if the approver approves within 30 minutes. Check with request_status. | none |
| `jellyfin_sessions` | read | jellyfin | coder | Who is on Jellyfin in the last 16 minutes: user, app, device name, and what is playing (paused or not). IPs and device ids are dropped. | none |
| `pve_guest_power` | approve | pve | coder | Start, shut down (clean ACPI shutdown) or reboot one Proxmox guest. Never runs straight away: it posts a request to the approver in Discord and returns a request id; it runs only if the approver approves within 30 minutes. Check with request_status. Only allowlisted guests; the workstation, secrets vault, agent host and the switchboard never are. | `vmid` (Guest id, e.g. 103), `action` (start, shutdown or reboot) |
| `pve_node_status` | read | pve | coder | The Proxmox host right now: uptime, CPU busy %, load, memory, swap, root disk, Proxmox and kernel versions. Live from the Proxmox API. | none |
| `pve_recent_tasks` | read | pve | coder | The Proxmox host's most recent tasks, newest first: type, guest id, user, status, start and end time (unix seconds). Backups, VM starts, apt updates. | `limit` (How many tasks, 1-50 (default 10)) |
| `request_status` | read | approvals | coder | Status of one of your approval requests: pending, executed, failed, denied or expired, with the result once it ran. | `id` (The request id an approve tool returned, e.g. r-0123456789ab) |
| `services_up` | read | prometheus | coder | Every target Prometheus scrapes, with up or down. A quick view of what is broken. | none |

## Approve-tier writes

- **`pve_guest_power`**: `POST /nodes/pve1/{qemu|lxc}/<vmid>/status/{start|shutdown|reboot}` with the separate token `power` of user `switchboard@pve` (role SwitchboardPower: VM.PowerMgmt + VM.Audit, set only on the allowlisted guests).
- **`jellyfin_library_scan`**: `POST /Library/Refresh` with the Jellyfin key.

Guests `pve_guest_power` may act on (`power_vmids` in `tools.yaml`): 102, 103, 112, 113, 120, 121, 130. Never: 100 workstation, 101 secrets vault, 150 agent host, 160 switchboard (refused by the config check too).

## Backends and their keys

Keys live in the secrets manager and on the switchboard host in `/etc/switchboard/secrets.env` (root, 0600), loaded as a systemd credential. No agent box ever holds one.

- **prometheus**: Prometheus `172.16.0.29:9090`. No key.
- **pve**: Proxmox API `https://172.16.0.88:8006`, user `switchboard@pve`, token `sb` (PVEAuditor: read-only; privilege-separated; expires yearly). TLS trusts only the cluster's `pve-root-ca.pem`.
- **jellyfin**: Jellyfin `http://172.16.0.91:8096`, app key `switchboard`. **Jellyfin has no read-only key, so this key is admin-level.** Read tools use a GET-only type; the one write, `POST /Library/Refresh`, sits in its own type and runs only after the approver's ✅.
- **approvals**: The switchboard's own request store (`/var/lib/switchboard/requests.json`). No key.

## Forwarded tools (tier forward)

Passed on unchanged to the agent's own MCP gateway, which keeps every guard of its own (its own rate limits and propose-only writes). The switchboard adds token -> tools -> backend (an agent reaches only the backend its `forward` names) and in-flight caps. Schemas are byte-identical to the gateway's tools/list (`upstream/<group>.json`, `gen.py --check-upstream`).

None configured in this example.
